Our experience at this hall was extremely disappointing.

1. **Very rude manager (Mr. Rahul):** He lacks basic management skills and has no sense of food timing. The dinner was delayed badly because he just waited for instructions. Due to this mismanagement, many of our guests **left the function without eating**, which was very embarrassing.

2. **Poor ambience and lighting:** The blue lighting in the hall **completely spoiled all our photos and videos**. The photographer’s effort and money were wasted, and our lifetime memories are ruined.

featured_reviews.name: pooja soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted our daughter’s 5th birthday at The Legacy Banquet at Witty International School and the experience was truly wonderful from start to finish. The venue itself has a very luxurious and elegant feel, making it a perfect place to host a special celebration. I can not express in words how beautiful the whole experience was 🙌🏻

A special appreciation goes to Manish Bhai for the absolutely stunning décor. Every detail was thoughtfully planned and executed, and the setup looked elegant, vibrant and picture-perfect. The entire look of the event  created a memorable atmosphere especially for my daughter and for everyone present. The theme of ‘Princess  Mysha in THE FROZEN WORLD’ just looked perfect.

The overall operations and coordination were handled seamlessly by Saurabh, who ensured that everything ran smoothly throughout the event. His professionalism, responsiveness, and ability to manage things efficiently made the entire experience stress-free for us.

When it comes to the food, it was truly one of the highlights of the evening. The menu was thoughtfully curated and the quality of every dish was excellent. A big thank you to Rajiv Velker, who was the overall food in-charge, for ensuring that everything was perfectly planned and executed. The food was delicious, beautifully presented and  widely appreciated by our guests at the end of the event. Rajiv ji just told me one thing at the end I just wanted everyone to be happy and he added lots of dishes by him self to enhance the overall experience 🙌🏻

Special mention to Tirupati Dingale, the F&B In-charge, for managing the service so efficiently and ensuring that everything was well organized and timely. The service team was attentive, courteous, and very well coordinated. They were constantly on their toes to serve everyone and were present at almost every table, something we rarely see these days. The entire team was so well trained that every guest felt personally attended to and genuinely cared for throughout the event. (My friends and family actually called me to mention this)

A heartfelt appreciation also goes to Head Chef Hemant Sawant, whose culinary expertise truly reflected in the taste and quality of the dishes served. Every item was prepared with great care and flavour, leaving a lasting impression on our guests. (Guests personally came up to us to mention how amazing the food was)

Another aspect worth highlighting is the excellent hygiene and cleanliness maintained throughout the venue. Everything was kept extremely neat and well managed, which added to the comfort and overall positive experience of the event.

From the luxurious ambiance and beautiful décor to the exceptional food and smooth management, every aspect of our event at The Legacy Banquet was handled with great professionalism and dedication. We would highly recommend this venue to anyone looking for a place that offers elegance, quality and outstanding service with wide variety of food.

I truly feel that when my daughter grows up and looks back at the pictures and memories of her celebration, she will say, “My parents chose a place that made my special day look like a dream.”

Once again a big Thank you to the entire team of Legacy Banquets 🙏🏻🙌🏻
Honestly, I wish there was an option to give more than just 5 stars 🌟, because the team truly deserves it.

With Love and gratitude,
Pooja Suchak & Shyam Suchak

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Legacy Banquet – Chikuwadi (Elite Exhibition – Shadisakhi)
Visited Legacy Banquet at Chikuwadi for the Elite Exhibition – Shadisakhi, and it was a very well organized event experience.
The banquet hall is spacious, clean, and well maintained, making it perfect for exhibitions, weddings, and large gatherings. Stall setup and layout were nicely arranged, allowing smooth movement for visitors.
Lighting, air-conditioning, and overall ambience were very good, creating a comfortable environment even with good crowd.
Management and coordination of the event were handled properly, and the venue supported the exhibition setup very well.
Parking facility nearby and location is easy to access.
Overall, a great venue for exhibitions and social functions. Highly recommended 👍

You can plan quite a variety of events at a place like Legacy Banquet, but not everything works equally well. The venue shines for structured, mid-to-large indoor gatherings rather than niche or highly technical events.
